title: HYPE INTERNAL 122 First-Signal / Dual-Scope Audit

candidate_generation.note: 100% candidate coverage is reachability, not detector precision.

false_10m_probe_to_invalidation.interpretation: EARLY probe must remain small and immediately invalidate on a new same-side extreme.

expanding_walk_forward.conclusion: The attractive single 45m holdout did not remain stable across expanding chronological folds.

single_holdout_research_only.warning: The latter filters were observed after inspecting the holdout and are not valid untouched OOS evidence. They are not promotion rules.

old_static_rules_on_broad_121.conclusion: Strict-tuned thresholds cannot be promoted as broad INTERNAL rules.

architecture_decision.strict_role: CORE structure; direction change still requires separate forward evidence
architecture_decision.first_signal_objective: A later true local never erases an earlier false accepted signal.
architecture_decision.same_side_rule: New/better same-side pivot supersedes the old provisional pivot; old provisional is false.
architecture_decision.future_guard: Teacher lookahead is label-only and every H1 row is filtered by completion time.

historical_data_limit.note: The old compact candidate artifact did not retain full raw L50/liquidation state for the 27 INTERNAL locals absent from the old candidate space. Missing historical inputs are not synthesized.

bottom_line: Candidate reachability is solved on the 30D artifact. Historical data do not prove an ideal first-signal detector. The correct finished research architecture is dual-scope terminal teachers plus automatic forward first-signal scoring; live promotion remains blocked until forward evidence passes the declared gate.
